provinceNotices.QC: In Québec, securities activities are overseen by the Autorité des marchés financiers (AMF). The title "financial planner" is reserved by law; this tool is not a financial planner or a registered adviser. For personalized advice, consult a registered professional.
provinceNotices.ON: In Ontario, the titles "financial planner" and "financial advisor" are protected under the FSRA title protection framework; this tool uses neither title and is not a registered adviser. For personalized advice, consult a credentialed professional.
